{{Top|leg}}
The '''Revos Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in [[Revos]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. It was a [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] circle two or more [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter, with [[Ferrocrete/Legends|ferrocrete]] bunkers scattered all over.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] controlled the planet. Four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] were kept in constant readiness at the spaceport in case of an attack, two of which were stolen by members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]], during their [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to Storinal.<ref name="WS" />
